description: Overhaul CSS tokens/variables system: replace oklch colors with DESIGN.md hex-based tokens, add all semantic colors, node/category palette, gradient tokens, shadow tokens, motion/animation tokens, spacing/layout tokens, and map everything to shadcn's expected variable names. Also add Inter font loading, typography tokens, theme transition class, and update layout breakpoints/dimensions.
steps: Rewrite `web/styles/globals.css` :root and .dark blocks to use the DESIGN.md hex-based color tokens. Keep the @import structure, @theme inline block, and @layer base block. The :root block should define all light mode tokens: brand colors (primary #5e6ad2, secondary #e8725c, highlight #f0a03c with hover/active/muted/subtle variants), canvas/surface layers (#fafaf8, #f4f3f0, #ffffff, #f8f7f5, #f0efec, #e8e7e4), ink colors (#1a1a2e, #4a4a5e, #7a7a8e, #9a9aae, #c0c0cc), hairline borders (#e8e7e4, #d8d7d4, #5e6ad2 focus), shadows (sm/md/lg/xl), overlay, semantic colors (success/warning/danger/info with bg and muted variants), forum-specific colors (unread-dot, online-indicator, exp-bar, bounty-gold, vote states, trending, sticky), node/category colors (10 colors), gradient tokens, motion/animation tokens (durations, easings), spacing tokens (xxs through section), layout tokens (sidebar-width, content-max-width, header-height, etc.), rounded tokens (xs through full), z-index scale, and typography tokens (font-sans with Inter, font-mono with JetBrains Mono). The .dark block should override all color tokens with the dark mode values from DESIGN.md.

Map new design system tokens to shadcn's expected CSS variables so existing components keep working. Map: --background to canvas, --foreground to ink, --card to surface-1, --card-foreground to ink, --popover to surface-2, --popover-foreground to ink, --primary to primary brand color, --primary-foreground to on-primary, --secondary to surface-2, --secondary-foreground to ink, --muted to surface-3, --muted-foreground to ink-muted, --accent to surface-2, --accent-foreground to ink, --destructive to semantic-danger, --border to hairline, --input to hairline, --ring to primary. Keep --radius, --sidebar-* vars, --dashboard-* vars, and --chart-* vars.
Update the @theme inline block in globals.css to add any new Tailwind utility mappings needed (the existing ones for shadcn colors should still work; add font-sans/font-mono references if needed).

Rewrite `web/styles/variables.css` to contain: (a) gradient tokens as CSS custom properties, (b) the theme-transitioning class for smooth 200ms theme switch transitions (background-color, color, border-color), (c) body background using the new canvas token, (d) forum-specific variables that were previously there (topics-nav colors mapped to new surface/primary-subtle tokens).

Update `web/styles/common.css` to: (a) update breakpoints to match DESIGN.md (max-width: 639px for mobile, 1023px for tablet, 1279px for desktop), (b) set header height reference to 52px instead of 56px where referenced (the dock-nav sticky top calc), (c) update sidebar/right-container widths to use 240px where applicable, (d) set content max-width to 720px where applicable. Keep the existing class structure (.main, .main-container, etc.) but update numeric values.

Add Inter font via a <link> to Google Fonts in `web/app/root.tsx` <head> section (add preconnect and font stylesheet for Inter with weights 400,500,600,700 and display=swap). Also add JetBrains Mono with weight 400.

Add keyframe definitions for animations from DESIGN.md to `web/styles/variables.css`: shimmer (for skeleton loading), slide-up (for toasts), modal-enter (scale 0.95->1 + fade), dropdown-enter (translateY -4px->0 + fade), checkin-pop (scale 1->1.05->1).
Add prefers-reduced-motion media query that disables animations.
acceptance_criteria: All shadcn/ui CSS variables (--primary, --background, --foreground, --card, --border, --muted, --accent, --destructive, --secondary, --popover, --ring, --input) are defined in both :root and .dark with values from DESIGN.md
All DESIGN.md color tokens are available as CSS custom properties (--color-canvas, --color-surface-1 through 4, --color-ink, --color-primary, --color-secondary, etc.)
Node/category colors are defined (--color-node-blue through --color-node-indigo) for both modes
Semantic colors (--color-semantic-success, warning, danger, info with -bg and -muted variants) are defined for both modes
Motion tokens (--motion-duration-*, --motion-easing-*) are defined as CSS custom properties
Spacing tokens (--spacing-*) are defined as CSS custom properties
Shadow tokens (--shadow-sm through --shadow-xl) are defined for both modes
Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts are loaded and assigned to --font-sans and --font-mono
Keyframe animations (shimmer, slide-up, modal-enter, dropdown-enter, checkin-pop) are defined
verification: Run `pnpm typecheck` in web/ directory and confirm it passes
Run `pnpm build` in web/ directory and confirm it succeeds
findings: Build and typecheck pass cleanly. The @theme inline block already had --font-sans mapped; added --font-mono. The dock-nav in topic.css already used 52px so no change needed there. shadcn/ui variables are now mapped via var() references to design system tokens, keeping all component compatibility. The --body-background legacy variable was moved from variables.css into globals.css :root/.dark blocks for consistency.
